scope: Separate CC0/public geometry release; only braid polylines, no fish payload; original fish/geometry-source HOLD and EOG-WF 3/31/3 unchanged. Not full 22 reach graph.
metadata_date_issue: 200800813 is malformed; do not silently correct. 20130831 listed by NAIP and PlaneCam but counted once in distinct date registry, 30 labels including malformed one. Resolve malformed label only using actual archive filenames and provenance.
crs: UTM Zone 10N, NAD83(NSRS2011) as described by metadata; require actual .prj validation, do not equate to original fish survey NAD83 realization.
quality: horizontal uncertainty estimated <7m, potentially greater with vegetation; no formal topology tests; mainstem intentionally digitized continuously, approximated short parts 20121127 and 20130116. Snapshot water-connected lines, not calibrated fish passage, depth or temporal persistence.

access.redirects: No automatic redirect; record HTTP error or redirect as HOLD, no source retry.

analysis: ZIP safety, CRC, SHA256 content digest (publisher digest not established), member stem/date/reach labels, mandatory .shp/.shx/.dbf/.prj, pyshp read only from memory if available; check shape/record counts, RiverReach and Length_m fields, finite geometry and lengths, .prj consistency, per-date/per-reach counts and length summaries. No topology inference, snapping, area, fish movement or ecological score in this gate. Record incomplete or differing schemas, do not invent missing dates. Retain explicit artifact digest. No archive member extracted to disk; no raw geometry committed.
stop: Access error or unavailable library means HOLD, no invented geometry. No repeated attempts against same denied URL. If no archive, complete metadata-only date/coverage audit. No main merge.
